observations: Photo 0 shows a wall-mounted/standing rechargeable fan with a circular grille and 3 black blades.
Photo 0 shows a charging/handle unit attached to the fan body (looks like a battery/charging base or power module).
Photo 1 shows a close view of the fan front grille and center hub; the brand text on the hub is not clearly readable.
Photo 1 shows the fan head and the side power module; no battery label, model number, or capacity is visible.

claims.claim: Used Qasa rechargeable fan for sale.
claims.evidence: The hub/brand name is not clearly readable in photo 0 or photo 1.

claims.claim: Lasts up to 2 hours when fully charged and longer when on low.
claims.evidence: No battery runtime test, charge indicator, or battery capacity label is shown in the photos.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year.
claims.evidence: Photos do not show purchase date/receipt; wear level is not enough to confirm 'barely used'.

claims.claim: No fault at all, the motor was never opened.
claims.evidence: Photos cannot confirm internal motor condition or whether it was opened.
No receipt/warranty card is shown in the photos.

risks.risk: Battery health may be weak, reducing runtime well below the claimed 2 hours.
risks.proof: A short video showing the fan running on high from full charge with a visible timer/phone stopwatch, plus the charge indicator (if any).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a rechargeable fan with unknown/possibly reduced battery runtime (worst case: not meeting the claimed runtime).

risks.risk: Charging system may be faulty (won’t charge fully or charges intermittently).
risks.proof: A video showing charging from empty to full (or showing the charging indicator changing) and then immediate operation.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed to charge properly until proven.

risks.risk: Fan may have performance issues (wobble, noise, weak airflow, blade imbalance).
risks.proof: A video of the fan running at low and high speeds, filmed from the front and side to show stability and airflow.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as average/possibly weak performance (worst case: not 'like new').

risks.risk: Brand/model mismatch (photos don’t clearly confirm 'Qasa' or the exact model), affecting correct comparables and value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the brand/model label on the hub or the power module (close-up, readable text).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic rechargeable fan without confirmed brand/model.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the hub/power module label showing brand and model (readable text).
Video: charge from near-empty to full with a visible indicator/timer, then run on high for a timed test.
Video: run on low and high showing airflow strength and any noise/vibration.
Photos of the receipt and warranty card (with dates/serial numbers visible).
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a rechargeable fan, but the brand/model and the key value drivers (battery runtime/charging health) are not verifiable remotely. Ask for a timed runtime + charging proof and a readable model label before pricing confidently.
